method: Two samples of 20 drawn with seed 20261125 by naics_measure.py and read: (a) six-digit codes in the SBA size-standards table of 13 CFR 121.201 against the Census 2022 NAICS list; (b) three- to five-digit codes present in both the Census 2022 list and NAICS Canada 2022.

sba_census.note: All 20 codes carry the same industry title on both sides, 19 character for character; the other differs only in punctuation. The BLS QCEW title for the same code agrees in all 20.

statcan_census.note: All 20 are the same class. Titles differ in capitalisation, spelling (Grantmaking / Grant-making) and once in wording (71399: 'All Other Amusement and Recreation Industries' / 'Other amusement and recreation industries'). The Census workbook ends some titles with a 'T' marker, which the comparison strips. Six-digit codes were not hand-checked: they are national detail, and only 492 of 1,012 US six-digit codes exist in NAICS Canada.
